title: enqueueChangeDeployments
responsibility: Queues an ordered automatic deployment chain for a verified source commit, capped at preprod.

inputs.name: enqueueChangeDeployments.root
inputs.description: Absolute Git repository directory whose source and deployment receipts are inspected.

inputs.name: enqueueChangeDeployments.input
inputs.type: { environment: DeploymentEnvironment; commit: string; projectId: string | null }
inputs.description: Requested environment and immutable source commit with the originating project identity.

inputs.name: enqueueChangeDeployments.runtime
inputs.description: Deployment adapter and injected execution, health and progress callbacks.

outputs.name: enqueueChangeDeployments
outputs.description: Ordered queued jobs; each predecessor must succeed before the next destination begins.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsafe source, target or promotion state; no successful deployment receipt is recorded.
